name: Summit Industrial Park
summary: Summit Industrial Park is a professionally managed industrial complex in Tehachapi, California, offering flexible commercial and industrial units for lease. Owned by Mike and Kim Nixon, the facility provides businesses with affordable space and strategic access to major transportation corridors connecting Central and Southern California.
demographics: Summit Industrial Park serves the Tehachapi business community, which caters to a diverse demographic including industrial workers, small business owners, and entrepreneurs in the greater Kern County area. The trade area draws from Tehachapi's population of approximately 14,000 residents with a median household income around $50,000-$60,000, representing a mix of working-class families and retirees. The industrial park primarily attracts business-to-business traffic rather than retail shoppers, serving manufacturing, warehousing, and light industrial operations typical of the region's economic base.
description: Summit Industrial Park is a professional industrial complex located in Tehachapi, California, offering flexible commercial and industrial space for businesses seeking a strategic location in Kern County. Owned and operated by Mike and Kim Nixon, this well-maintained facility provides multiple units available for lease, catering to a variety of business needs from light manufacturing to warehousing and distribution. Situated at 1582 Goodrick Drive in Tehachapi, the park benefits from the city's position along major transportation corridors connecting the Central Valley to Southern California, making it an ideal location for businesses requiring logistical access. The industrial park features modern amenities and professional management, with the owners personally involved in tenant relations and property maintenance. For businesses seeking affordable industrial space in a growing community with a business-friendly environment, Summit Industrial Park offers an attractive alternative to the higher costs of larger metropolitan areas while maintaining excellent accessibility to major markets.
